_comment: Story arcs -- AUTHORING apparatus, never a runtime system. An arc is one goal_flag reached by any of several ROUTES, so a looker, a reasoner and a maker arrive at the same understanding by different means. A route's unlock_when uses the same clause grammar as everything else (OR of ANDs: `observed` requires ALL listed memories, `flag` requires that flag, `stat` requires each named stat at that level). Nothing in the game reads this file -- it is checked at boot and findings go to wayworn-hush.log, so a renamed flag or a deleted encounter that strands a route is caught here rather than in play. Delete this file and the game plays identically. An arc with fewer than two routes is reported: a thread with one path is a design bug. See docs/design/MAP-ARCHITECTURE.md section 6.
